reviews.name: Ananya S.
reviews.text: My wedding jewelry from Lumière was the most complimented part of my entire look. The Polki necklace set is breathtaking in person — photos don't do it justice. The craftsmanship is museum-quality. My mother-in-law was so impressed she's ordered her own set.

reviews.name: Megha R.
reviews.text: I was nervous buying fine jewelry online but the packaging alone told me this was special. The Halo ring is delicate, perfectly sized, and the solitaire catches light from every angle. I've worn it daily for 6 months — still looks brand new. The buyback guarantee gave me confidence to buy.

reviews.name: Priya K.
reviews.text: Bought the Jharokha earrings as an anniversary gift for my wife. The luxury packaging, the handwritten note, the certificate — it felt like unboxing something from Cartier. My wife cried. Genuinely the best gift purchase I've ever made.

items.question: Is the gold BIS hallmarked?
items.answer: Yes, every piece carries the BIS hallmark (Bureau of Indian Standards). Our 22KT gold is 916 purity and 18KT is 750 purity — independently verified and stamped. Each piece comes with a Certificate of Authenticity.

items.question: What is your buyback policy?
items.answer: We offer lifetime buyback at the prevailing gold rate minus 2% deduction. You'll always get full value for your gold. Alternatively, you can exchange any piece for a new design at 100% gold value with zero deduction.

items.question: How are the diamonds sourced?
items.answer: All our natural diamonds are Kimberley Process certified. Our lab-grown diamonds are IGI certified. Every diamond above 0.3ct comes with an independent grading report. We believe in complete transparency.

items.question: Do you offer EMI?
items.answer: Yes, we offer No Cost EMI on all major credit cards for purchases above Rs. 10,000. Bajaj Finserv and ZestMoney options also available for extended flexible payment plans.
